title: $L^p$-Boundedness of Forelli-Rudin Type Operators on Rational Hartogs Triangles
summary: Let $ H_{m/n}=\{(z_1,z_2)\in\C^2:|z_1|^m 0$; for the operators with kernel $B_{m/n}(z,w)^N$, it holds for every $N\in\Z_+$. The conditions are necessary and sufficient and recover the sharp $L^p$-ranges of the Bergman projection and the Berezin transform.
